name: FMS^2
description: Segmenting thin structures like infrastructure cracks and anatomical vessels is a task hampered by topology-sensitive geometry, high annotation costs, and poor generalization across domains. Existing methods address these challenges in isolation. We propose FMS$^2$, a flow-matching framework with two modules. (1) SegFlow is a 2.96M-parameter segmentation model built on a standard encoder-decoder backbone that recasts prediction as continuous image $\rightarrow$ mask transport.
